text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHDOG02, Yorkie Front Door Knocker

The Yorkshire Terrier Door Knocker is a great way to let your visitors know about the person and the dog living in your home. This wonderfully detailed Yorkie Front Door Knocker captures beauty and aloofness that the breed is known for. This door knocker is made from solid bronze with a highlighted patina finish that really bring out the beauty of not only the coloring, but also the detailing. This Yorkie Front Door Knocker comes packaged with the mounting hardware to install it on wood or metal doors.

Features and Specifications of the Solid Bronze Yorkie Door Knocker:

  • Material: Solid Bronze
  • Finish: Solid Bronze with Highlighted Patina
  • Height: 5-1/2"
  • Width: 3-3/4"
  • Projection Off Door: 2-3/4
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
